study: CORD-v2 BF16 versus existing synthetic-calibrated AWQ
calibration: Existing AWQ export, 177 synthetic calibration questions; no CORD dev/test calibration or prompt tuning
primary_quality_metric: Literal field exact match after NFKC and outer whitespace stripping; not official CORD parsing F1
primary_quality_run: First concurrency-1 run of each variant; repeated requests do not increase the quality sample size
quality_margin_rule: Report whether the lower bound of each paired task delta CI is at least -2 pp; an inconclusive interval is not proof of equivalence
gate_scope: Predeclared research acceptance targets; not a customer's production SLA
performance_scope: Warm local HTTP SSE service, image encoding excluded from individual latency but included in workload wall time; same 2 GiB KV cache, prefix and processor caches disabled
startup_adjustments_before_any_inference: Use numeric CUDA device id and verify its UUID; vLLM 0.11 cannot parse UUID ids
Remove the global Triton override; Qwen3-VL vision does not support it, so let the pinned engine select supported vision and decoder backends
limitations: Single GPU and single server launch per variant
Sequential deployment order can leave thermal or temporal confounding
Client request fingerprints do not attest internal tensors
Existing synthetic calibration measures transfer to receipts, not receipt-calibrated AWQ
